question: What is the average total quantity across all final packaging combinations, considering only the leaf-level items within each combination after fully expanding any nested packaging relationships?
sql:
-- Average total quantity across all final packaging combinations
WITH RECURSIVE expanded AS (
    SELECT 
        p.id AS root_id,
        p.id AS current_id,
        CAST(1 AS BIGINT) AS cumulative_qty
    FROM packaging p
    WHERE p.id IN (SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)
      AND p.id NOT IN (SELECT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        e.root_id,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        e.cumulative_qty * pr.qty AS cumulative_qty
    FROM expanded e
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pr.packaging_id = e.current_id
),
leaf_items AS (
    SELECT 
        e.root_id,
        e.current_id AS leaf_id,
        e.cumulative_qty AS leaf_qty
    FROM expanded e
    WHERE e.current_id NOT IN (SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)
),
total_per_root AS (
    SELECT 
        root_id,
        SUM(leaf_qty) AS total_leaf_quantity
    FROM leaf_items
    GROUP BY root_id
)
SELECT AVG(total_leaf_quantity) AS avg_total_quantity
FROM total_per_root

    WHERE p.id IN (SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)
      AND p.id NOT IN (SELECT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        e.root_id,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        e.cumulative_qty * pr.qty AS cumulative_qty
    FROM expanded e
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pr.packaging_id = e.current_id
),
leaf_items AS (
    SELECT 
        e.root_id,
        e.current_id AS leaf_id,
        e.cumulative_qty AS leaf_qty
    FROM expanded e
    WHERE e.current_id NOT IN (SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)
),
total_per_root AS (
    SELECT 
        root_id,
        SUM(leaf_qty) AS total_leaf_quantity
    FROM leaf_items
    GROUP BY root_id
)
SELECT AVG(total_leaf_quantity) AS avg_total_quantity
FROM total_per_root
